# Third-party dependencies

Vendored, header-only dependencies. Each directory contains the upstream license.
Update a dependency by replacing its files with those from a newer upstream version
and updating the table below.

| Directory | Project | Version | Files | License |
|-----------|---------|---------|-------|---------|
| `stb/` | [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) | `f1c79c02822848a9bed4315b12c8c8f3761e1296` | `stb_image.h`, `stb_image_write.h` | MIT / Public Domain |
| `doctest/` | [doctest/doctest](https://github.com/doctest/doctest) | `v2.5.3` | `doctest.h` | MIT |
